title: The new Jerusalem comes down from heaven
description: One of the seven angels takes John up to a great and high mountain and shows him the bride, the Lamb’s wife: the holy city Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from God. The city shines with God’s glory, has a great wall with twelve gates bearing the names of the tribes of Israel and twelve foundations bearing the names of the apostles. The angel measures the city as twelve thousand stadia in length, width, and height; the wall is made of jasper and the city of pure gold. The foundations are adorned with twelve precious stones, and the gates are twelve pearls. There is no temple there, for God and the Lamb are its temple, and the city has no need of sun or moon. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s book of life may enter it.
